question: What are the name of badge that users who have the highest reputation obtained?
evidence: highest reputation refers to Max(Reputation); user refers to UserId
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT T2.name AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1.Reputation DESC) AS __r FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T2.name FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId ORDER BY T1.Reputation DESC LIMIT 1

c.request:
What are the name of badge that users who have the highest reputation obtained?
Evidence: highest reputation refers to Max(Reputation); user refers to UserId
If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
c.sql: SELECT b.Name FROM badges AS b JOIN users AS u ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users);

b.request: List the names of badges earned by users whose reputation equals the maximum reputation among all users, including all badges tied at the cutoff
b.sql: SELECT b.Name FROM badges AS b JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = b.UserId WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users);

d.request: What are the names of the badges earned by users with the highest reputation? Include all users tied for the highest reputation.
d.sql: SELECT DISTINCT b.Name FROM badges AS b JOIN users AS u ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users);
